title: TargetInputField
description: A test-design association that binds one input field of a TestCoverageTarget's artifact (an API parameter, data-model property or UI input) to the InputSpacePartition used to divide that field into equivalence classes. It also records whether the field must appear in test inputs for that target. Use InputSpacePartition instead when you are defining the equivalence classes of an input dimension itself, independent of which target or field uses them. Use InputPartitionSelection instead when you are stating which values of a partition a specific CoverageRequirement must exercise, rather than which partition governs a target's field. Use InputSelection instead when you are binding a concrete test datum to a partition value for an individual TestCaseSketch. Use TestCoverageTarget instead when the symbol represents the endpoint, workflow or component under test as a whole, not one of its input fields.

fieldRef.description: ID of the referenced field element in the API layer (e.g., an API parameter) or Data Model layer (e.g., a data-model property)

partitionRef.description: ID of the testing.inputspacepartition that defines the equivalence classes or boundary values for this input field.

description.description: Free-text note on why this field matters for testing the target, such as validation rules or known defect history. Set it when the field's relevance or chosen partition is not self-evident from fieldRef and partitionRef.

relevance.description: Whether this field must be included in test case input specifications

x-dr-standard: IEEE 829-2008 Clause 11 Level Test Case, inputs, informed by Level Test Design equivalence-partitioning features
x-dr-evidence: A parameterized test (pytest.mark.parametrize, JUnit @ParameterizedTest/@MethodSource) whose parameter is named after one request field of the endpoint under test, with value sets grouped as valid/invalid/boundary.
A per-endpoint test-data map or fixture keyed by request field name (e.g. {"email": EMAIL_CASES, "age": AGE_BOUNDARIES}) that pairs each field with a reusable case list.
A property-based or schema-driven generator bound to a single DTO/OpenAPI parameter (Hypothesis st.builds field override, fast-check arbitrary, Schemathesis hook for one parameter).
